pages.text: This is Mars. Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun. It is a cold, rocky world.

quickWords.th: ลำดับที่สี่
เต็มไปด้วยหิน

pages.text: Mars is called the Red Planet. There is iron in its rocks and dust. The iron has changed into rusty minerals, making Mars look red.

quickWords.th: ดาวเคราะห์สีแดง
แร่ที่เป็นสนิม

pages.text: Mars is not flat and empty. It has plains, craters, mountains, volcanoes and deep valleys. Every place has a story.

quickWords.th: หลุมอุกกาบาต

pages.text: Mars turns around and around. One day on Mars is called a sol. A sol is only a little longer than a day on Earth.
Mars has seasons too. It has spring, summer, autumn and winter. But one year on Mars lasts 687 Earth days.

quickWords.th: ฤดูใบไม้ร่วง

pages.text: Mars has an atmosphere. But its air is very thin. It is made mostly of a gas called carbon dioxide.

quickWords.th: คาร์บอนไดออกไซด์

pages.text: Mars is usually very cold. Even when the Sun shines, the ground can be freezing. Mars is a cold desert.
The Martian air is thin, but it can still move. Wind lifts the fine red dust. Sometimes huge dust storms spread across Mars.

quickWords.th: ของดาวอังคาร
ฝุ่นสีแดงละเอียด

pages.text: Mars is the Red Planet. But near sunset, something surprising can happen. The sky around the Sun can glow blue.

quickWords.th: พระอาทิตย์ตก
น่าประหลาดใจ
เรืองแสงสีฟ้า

pages.text: Mars has ice. There is water ice at its poles and under parts of the ground. In winter, even carbon dioxide can freeze into ice.

quickWords.th: น้ำแข็งจากน้ำ

pages.text: Mars did not always look the way it does today. Billions of years ago, liquid water flowed across its surface. Mars was wetter than it is now.

quickWords.th: หลายพันล้าน
น้ำในสถานะของเหลว

pages.text: Rivers once cut valleys into Mars. Water filled some craters and made lakes. Where rivers met lakes, they sometimes built deltas from mud and sand.

quickWords.th: ดินดอนสามเหลี่ยมปากแม่น้ำ
